web/src/i18n/en.ts.name: English text
web/src/i18n/en.ts.description: Holds every piece of on-screen text in English; it is the master copy and the fallback for the other languages.

web/src/i18n/enums-audit.ts.name: Activity log labels
web/src/i18n/enums-audit.ts.description: Gives readable names to the kinds of actions and record types shown in the activity log.

web/src/i18n/enums-commerce.ts.name: Sales labels
web/src/i18n/enums-commerce.ts.description: Gives readable names to discount reasons and list-price choices on the sales screen.

web/src/i18n/enums-key.ts.name: Label key type
web/src/i18n/enums-key.ts.description: Makes sure each label name points at text that really exists in the English catalog.

web/src/i18n/enums-operations.ts.name: Farm operations labels
web/src/i18n/enums-operations.ts.description: Gives readable names to water sources, units, egg grades, inventory and stock movement types.

web/src/i18n/enums-settings.ts.name: Settings and roles labels
web/src/i18n/enums-settings.ts.description: Gives readable names to staff roles and the choices on the settings screen.

web/src/i18n/enums-status.ts.name: Status labels
web/src/i18n/enums-status.ts.description: Gives readable names to the small status labels shown across screens.

web/src/i18n/enums.ts.name: Fixed-choice labels
web/src/i18n/enums.ts.description: Collects all the label families so a stored value, like a role or a status, is shown with a translated name.

web/src/i18n/es.ts.name: Spanish text
web/src/i18n/es.ts.description: Holds the on-screen text in Spanish, machine-drafted and still waiting for a native speaker to review it.

web/src/i18n/index.ts.name: Language setup
web/src/i18n/index.ts.description: Sets up the supported languages, loads Spanish and Tagalog when needed and gives up if a language takes too long.

web/src/i18n/resolve.ts.name: Language chooser
web/src/i18n/resolve.ts.description: Picks the language to show: the person's own choice, then the farm's locale, then English.

web/src/i18n/tl.ts.name: Tagalog text
web/src/i18n/tl.ts.description: Holds the on-screen text in Tagalog, machine-drafted and still waiting for a native speaker to review it.

web/src/i18n/translations-status.ts.name: Translated sections list
web/src/i18n/translations-status.ts.description: Lists which sections of text are kept translated in step with English.
